QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_40

question.text: Which international reporting-standards frameworks are Indian AIFs increasingly adopting, per Chapter 13.3?

answer.text: IFRS, US GAAP, Ind AS, CAS
Basel III, Solvency II, IFRS 9, IFRS 17

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 13.3 explicitly names: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) by CFA Institute, Institutional Limited Partners Association (ILPA), International Private Equity and Venture Capital (IPEV) Valuation Board, and European Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (EVCA). **The Trap:** Option B is accounting-standard acronyms. Option C is prudential/insurance regulatory. Option D is tax-compliance framework. All are distractors. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D also list these. XV (RA) references GIPS for performance presentation. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Aligning with GIPS 2020 (CFA) gives credibility with global institutional LPs. Cat III hedge-fund-style reporting under GIPS is feasible; ILPA-style capital accounting is more PE-flavoured but increasingly used.
